allowed.reason: A host group name: members of the docker group are root-equivalent, so the service-account check treats it as admin-like. It is about the host, not the Docker widget.
Widget categories are a fixed list of picker labels any package may use (a manifest's category field); they are not widget types.
The WidgetCategory type is the same fixed list of picker labels; any package may pick one.
"network" is the manifest field that lists the hosts a package's lookups may contact, not a widget type.
A comment naming the manifest field "network" (the allowed lookup hosts).
SNAPSHOT_SECTIONS lists the sections the collectors write into every snapshot (generic host data any widget may read); sections are core data, not widget types.
